kestrel.main:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D pixel-game animation source spritesheet.
Generate exactly ONE transparent PNG spritesheet for KESTREL, an original playable tiny bird needle-archer for a dark Scandinavian garden action roguelite. Kestrel is a sharp angular russet-and-cream kestrel bird, fully avian, long gold pointed beak, two slender taloned bird legs, short wings holding a small dark yew bow, extremely long forked rusty tail, one luminous amber eye. NO human body, NO clothes, NO helmet. Beautiful bold memorable silhouette. Strong simple clusters and restrained high-contrast 12-colour palette: near-black plum, dark aubergine, deep chestnut, vermilion, rust, tawny, ochre, bone cream, pale yellow, muted teal accents. Hard square pixel edges, purposeful classic hand-pixelled look: each figure will become 24 pixels tall. No tiny stippled textures.
Layout MUST be EXACT 8 columns by 8 rows, 64 distinct frames, perfectly uniform square cells, 1024x1024 total. Each invisible cell 128x128, figure comfortably within central 104x104 area with clear transparent gutters, consistent planted feet at cell y=116 and horizontal anchor x=64. Nothing overlaps cells. Right-facing profile throughout except natural movement. All frames show full body. No grid, no labels, no text, no background, no floor shadow.
Rows of eight sequential unique animation poses, left to right:
1 relaxed breathing idle, chest expands, tail flicks and blink, stays grounded.
2 walking cycle, eight clear alternating avian leg poses, wing and tail follow-through.
3 running cycle, low lean, wider talon strides, tail stream and wing counterbalance.
4 look and alert: head turns up, notices danger, small wing stretch, settles.
5 jump: crouch anticipation, toe launch, rising with spread wings, apex, feet tucked, falling, extended legs, landing.
6 landing and crouch: low compression then stand, repeat gentle squat; strong shape changes.
7 needle bow shot: reach, draw back bow, fully drawn, release long needle, wings recoil, recover, settle.
8 garden care: crouch reach into soil, peck and dig, sow one seed, pour from a tiny seedpod, pick sprout, raise glowing pod lantern, sit, sleep.
Keep character identity absolutely consistent in every cell, move limbs and deform body for real fluid animations, never duplicate a static pose. Transparent background.

ROW 2, all 8 frames: dig the soil with own root/wing/stone fist: reach, prepare, reach out, hit ground, scoop, lift clod, scatter, recover.
ROW 3, all 8 frames: sow a seed. Reach pouch, take seed, hold to right, kneel, lower hand/wing/root, open grip, deposit seed, return.
ROW 4, all 8 frames: water with a small dark turquoise seedpod watering vessel: lift, aim, tilt, pouring, pouring continued, deeper tilt, stop pour, lower.
ROW 5, all 8 frames: harvest a tiny plant: reach, grip, pull, lift, detach, show, store, recover.
ROW 6, all 8 frames: signature attack. Draw a small yew bow and release a long needle arrow. Strong anticipation, action, follow-through, recovery.
ROW 7, all 8 frames: lantern: take small amber lamp, lift halfway, raise, extend arm/wing/root, then four different still raised-lantern breathing poses.
ROW 8, all 8 frames: rest: lower, half sit, sit, settle, tuck appendages, close eyes, then two sleeping breathing poses.
Real pose-to-pose movement throughout each row, no repeated still sprite. Simple crisp low-resolution pixel art on genuinely transparent background. Preserve the reference creature identity.

Tiny dark eyes on the stem beneath the canopy. NO human head, no human clothes, no human anatomy, no helmet. Cap is dominant and wider than body, little drifting spores. Memorable bold readable silhouette. High contrast 12-colour palette: near-black purple, dark plum, wine red, coral red, faded salmon, warm cream, ivory, dark forest, dark teal, turquoise, pale mint and gold. Hard square pixel edges, bold simple connected clusters, no noisy stippling. Each sprite becomes about 22 pixels tall.
